senses.gloss:
अह्न अह्न, अस्, m. as last member of a
compound = अहन्, a day, q. v.; e. g. मध्याह्न,
midday; अपराह्ण, afternoon.

आह्न आह्न, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. अहन्), a series
of days, many days.
अह्नाय, ind. formerly; instantly; soon, speedily.

अह्निक, अस्, आ, अम्, as last member of a compound
= अहन्; e. g. द्व्य्-अह्निक, अस्, आ, अम्, lasting two
days.

आह्निक, अस्, ई, अम्, daily, diurnal, performed on a
day, performed every day; (अम्), n. a religious cere-
mony to be performed every day at a fixed hour; a
day's work, what may be read on one day, the division
or section of a book; constant occupation, daily work;
daily food, &c.
—आह्निकाचार (˚क-आच्˚), अस्, m. daily
observance, the prayers and practices necessary for
bodily and mental purification.

अह्नी, f. and अह्नीय, अस्, आ, अम्, or अह्न्य, अस्, आ,
अम् (all fr. अहन्), used at the end of compounds;
e. g. रथाह्न्य, अम्, n. the daily journey of a
chariot.

अह्नवाय्य अ-ह्नवाय्य, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. ह्नु),
Ved. not to be denied or set aside; (अस्), m. accord-
ing to Sāy. the N. of a king.
आह्नेय, अस्, m. a patronymic of Śauca.
